section_header: FRONT AXLE AND SUSPENSION — Front Wheel Alignment
title: ADJUST TOE-IN / INSPECT SIDE SLIP WITH SIDE SLIP TESTER

content.description: Vehicle positioned for measuring height, showing front wheels with measuring height indicator and directional arrow

items: (a) Make sure the wheels are positioned straight ahead.
(b) Mark the center of each rear tread and measure the distance between the marks of right and left tires.
(c) Advance the vehicle until the marks on the rear of the tires come to the front.

content.text: The toe-in should be measured at the same point on the tire and at the same level.

content.description: Top view diagram showing toe-in measurement with dimension A at front and dimension B at rear, formula B - A = Toe-in

content.text: (d) Measure the distance between the marks on the front of the tires.

content.description: Two detailed views of tie rod adjustment mechanism showing rack boot clips and clamp bolts on left and right sides

items: (e) Remove the rack boot clips and loosen the clamp bolts.
(f) Adjust toe-in by turning the left and right tie rod tubes an equal amount.

content.text: Make sure that the tie rods are the same length.
(g) Tighten the clamp bolts and torque them.
8. INSPECT SIDE SLIP WITH SIDE SLIP TESTER
If the side slip exceeds the limit, the toe-in or other front wheel alignment may not be correct.

content.description: Side view of tire on side slip tester showing concentric circles and testing plate
